label: PF Backlog 539
title: C7: Secret broker (model sees credential_ref, never the secret; inject only into the authorized runtime)
body:
## Problem / why
Secrets must never reach the LLM; today we only SCAN for them.
## Acceptance criteria
Agents request a capability; a broker authorizes + injects the secret into the controlled tool/runtime; the model receives a reference (credential_ref), never the value; audited.
